title: Index Column
rationale: A vertical series of numbered tabs emphasizes retrieval and handover.
visual_system: Tall rectangular index motif, tabular lettering, clay and charcoal palette.
tradeoffs: Index details would need simplification for cover stamps and tiny icons.
differentiation: The reference is a notebook’s information architecture. A market search remains outside this demo.
provenance: Original written exploration with no external design inputs.
